## Aero-MRO-Sync (N8N-API-AERO-PRJ-10)
**Before running:**
1. Run mock-mro-server.js, then edit **Config** (URLs default to localhost:3001/3002; use host.docker.internal if n8n is in Docker)
2. Assign Postgres credential to every *PG* node + SMTP credential to *Email* nodes
3. Create tables from schema.sql
4. Activate workflow (static-data mutexes persist only in production runs)
5. Optional (self-hosted): set `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto` so Phase 1 uses node:crypto.timingSafeEqual; otherwise it auto-falls back to a pure-JS HMAC

## Phase 6-7 HITL gate
Wait node resumes on POST `{"decision":"APPROVED"}` to the resume URL sent via Slack/Email.

## Phase 8-10 REST loop
OAuth2 mutex -> POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE one at a time.
400 -> POISON_PILL_400 DLQ (0 retries) | 429 -> jittered backoff | 5xx -> hot failover -> DLQ
